notes: Baseline and candidate both passed 469 shared-transport checks/240 updates plus121 ownership checks/12 explicit memory.grow operations in both Node and real Chrome.
Public Topos class TypeScript declarations are unchanged. Generated low-level WASM ABI changes with the return representation: always keep each generated wrapper paired with its WASM binary.
Candidate was built from the tracked patch and then committed without changing those source bytes; candidate-build.json records the build checkout and source-freeze distinction.

547 clock samples are zero. Any ratio with a zero arm median is omitted, never treated as a 100% speedup. The initial derived summary remains local; the corrected null-ratio derivation is used for publication.
This is synthetic closed-loop shared-gate learning, not pretrained fine-tuning, general optimizer speed, WebGPU, independent mathematics or model-quality evidence.
Rust semantic core/NN and Python sources are unchanged; Python and Torch were not rebuilt or retimed for this WASM transport-only change.
